title: Atmospheric CO2
blurb: Monthly CO2 at Mauna Loa since 1958: a steady rise with a yearly cycle.

title: Sunspots
blurb: Monthly sunspot counts since 1749. The cycle lasts about 11 years and every peak is different.

title: Wikipedia views
blurb: Daily views of the English Wikipedia article on Python, with a weekly rhythm and holiday dips.

title: Language articles
blurb: Daily views of six programming language articles on the English Wikipedia, one row per day and article. Pick a series, or forecast all six and compare them.

title: Paris weather
blurb: Hourly temperature and humidity in Paris. Both columns are forecast together.

title: Bike rentals
blurb: Hourly bike rentals in Washington, D.C., in 2011 and 2012, with weather and holiday columns you can use as covariates.
